summary: Talkspace, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting stockholder approval of its acquisition by Universal Health Services (UHS) via a merger. The Merger Agreement, dated March 9, 2026, provides for Merger Sub to merge into Talkspace, with Talkspace surviving as an indirect wholly owned UHS subsidiary. The Merger Proposal received ~73.48% of outstanding shares voting in favor. The board recommended the deal; no advisors are named. The advisory compensation vote was not approved. The merger is subject to regulatory closing conditions; watch for regulatory clearance and any competing bids. Risk-arb spread will depend on remaining timeline and antitrust review.
